nodes.description: Constructor: wires _teamAddress/_marketingFunds, mints full reflection supply to _msgSender and sets fee exclusions; owner is implicitly the deployer.
Core transfer routine: enforces maxTx, bot list, cooldown (block.timestamp) and triggers swap/send of accumulated fees before finalizing balances.

Splits contract ETH 40/60 and pushes it out with address.transfer to team and marketing wallets.
